name: Centenary Partners Fund

funder.name: Norfolk Wildlife Trust (funded by nine business Centenary Partners)

summary: Small-grant fund for Norfolk community and conservation groups, CICs and small charities to create, maintain or protect spaces for nature, including tools, equipment and restoration projects.
reporting: A short end-of-project report, usually due within 1 to 2 months of completion, covering how the money was spent, how many people benefited and the outcomes achieved.

applicant_types.quote: Are a conservation and community group, club, society, Community Interest Company (CIC), or small charity.

geography.quote: Are carrying out activities and projects primarily within Norfolk.

access.quote: Calling local community and conservation groups - our Centenary Partners Fund is open for applications!

window.quote: Our Centenary Partners Fund opens for applications on Monday 2 November 2026, and the closing deadline is Friday 22 January 2027.
